description: A green-covered bed surface is in front with a tape dispenser in the middle and piles of colorful beads on the right, plus a brown cord and a red string off to the left. The right hand lifts the brown cord upward, then lowers it toward the bead piles and reaches over the dark blue beads; the left hand comes in to hold the other end of the cord, and the right hand brings a single dark blue bead to the cord and begins threading it on while both hands steady the cord as a two-hand object.
